steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Ace!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Looks like you all made it out alive.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: This isn't the rendezvous point... Why are you here alone?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: They're the ones who escaped from the central area! Don't let them get away!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Tsk, they just keep coming after us!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Team E2, prepare to intercept--

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Dobermann, don't get overzealous. Retreating is our top priority!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Amiya, Dr. {@nickname}! Quick!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: It's not safe here either.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: That's right. We still have to press on to the next rendezvous point.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Where's your team?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Where are you rats hiding? Smoke them out!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Here they come again!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, please give us your orders.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Just like the good ol' days.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um, Ace...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Actually, something unexpected has happened.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... is suffering from amnesia.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry, Ace... But compared to before, a lot has changed.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Is that so? You don't need to apologize to me.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Have the Doctor's commanding capabilities suffered as a result of the amnesia?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...As sharp as before.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor's decisionmaking is still absolutely reliable. I can promise you this.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Very well then. I'll follow the Doctor's orders then.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: What has been lost can be found again.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Right now, there's a more imminent problem on our hands.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: They're over here! Hurry, let's get them! !

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Are you done chatting yet? I'm going to go crack some skulls!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, please give us your orders.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Go. Release your inner beast, and let them feel your fangs!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Doctor! Ace! The enemy is right in front of us!

options: Seize the opportunity to disrupt the enemy's plans.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Team E3! Back up Dobermann!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: An ambush?!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Team E3 has been moving undercover this whole time... I see, they've been waiting for us to pincer the enemy.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: When communications are jammed, our teams should operate near the rendezvous point. That way, even if something happens to me or the scout...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: The broader operation can still be carried out. This is my decision-making.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: In other words, Ace, you left your team back at the rendezvous point and came here alone...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: After all, neutralizing threats around the rendezvous point is our top objective.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Of course, prioritizing checking on your status is a big risk. There's no way I could imperil the entire team.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: The whole reason teams exist is to increase tactical efficiency, not the other way around.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Hah. Let's continue our discussion after we've taken care of Reunion!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Amiya, you're up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Understood! I'll back you up with my Arts!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Finally...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, please command Rhodes Island.
